answer: Pay for work retroactively, by how much independent agents later rely on it. An agent that publishes a river-gauge model earns nothing at release; its share grows as unrelated buyers cite it in their own flood forecasts during the spring tide. A sybil farm can flood the ledger with a thousand reports that cite each other, but citations between linked identities are discarded, so the only signal that pays is downstream use by strangers, which clones can't manufacture.
